profile.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services plc operates as an integrated energy maritime logistics company worldwide. It operates through Integrated Logistics, Shipping, and Services segments. The company provides onshore and offshore logistics and transportation services to energy production facilities, including material handling, manpower and equipment supply, and storage facilities and related services; and office space, chemicals, catering, and other onshore and offshore oil and gas field services. It also offers EPC services related to dredging, land reclamation, and marine construction; freight and charter services for the transportation of oil, gas, and related petroleum products on ocean going vessels owned or hired from third parties; operates and maintains supply bases supporting those activities; vessels pooling, commercial management of vessels and bunker trading; petroleum ports operations services; and oil spill and hazardous and noxious substances response services. The company was founded in 1935 and is based in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates. ADNOC Logistics & Services plc is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company.

summary: ADNOC Logistics posted record Q2 2026 results: $2.6B revenue, $1.1B EBITDA, $951M net profit; raised FY guidance for third time this year.
FY 2026 outlook upgraded to mid-20% revenue growth, mid-60% EBITDA growth, and high 110% net profit growth versus 2025 levels.
Shipping segment drove earnings on elevated tanker rates; 19 of 50 planned vessels delivered under $5.7B capex program through 2029.
Geopolitical risks persist after Strait of Hormuz attacks damaged two VLCCs, causing casualties and 6-8 month repair timelines.
Management maintaining dividend policy despite strong quarter, prioritizing capital deployment into ADNOC-backed growth opportunities.
